summary.description: Dichloromethane is a clear, colourless, highly volatile liquid with a strong odour. It is non-flammable and used in various industrial applications.
emission_sources: Use in industrial and domestic products such as paint removers and solvents
environmental_impact: Can cause harm to local wildlife if released in large quantities
Releases to surface water may harm aquatic life, although it evaporates rapidly
May cause degradation of air quality in localized environments

top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: DCM is widely used in consumer and industrial products, and its safe use, handling, and disposal are crucial to minimize environmental and health impacts.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: High exposure to DCM can damage multiple human organs and may potentially cause cancer, making it a concern for occupational and public health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Releases to water bodies can harm aquatic organisms, despite rapid evaporation, posing a threat to water quality and ecosystem health.
